mapper.sql: id, direction, doc_type, partner_id, format, name, version, file_key, file_name, layout_json, is_default, enabled, deleted, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fin_statement_template WHERE doc_type=#{docType} AND direction=#{direction} AND format=#{format} AND enabled=1 AND deleted=0 AND partner_id IN (#{partnerId},0) ORDER BY CASE WHEN partner_id=#{partnerId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, is_default DESC, version DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM fin_statement_template WHERE doc_type=#{docType} AND direction=#{direction} AND enabled=1 AND deleted=0 AND partner_id IN (#{partnerId},0) ORDER BY CASE WHEN partner_id=#{partnerId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, is_default DESC, CASE format WHEN 'XLSX' THEN 0 WHEN 'PDF' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM fin_statement_template WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM fin_statement_template WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=0

SELECT id, partner_id, doc_type, direction, format, name, file_name, version, is_default, enabled, created_at, CASE WHEN layout_json IS NULL OR layout_json='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_layout FROM fin_statement_template WHERE doc_type=#{docType} AND direction=#{direction} AND deleted=0 AND partner_id=#{partnerId} ORDER BY partner_id, format, version DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version),0)+1 FROM fin_statement_template WHERE doc_type=#{docType} AND direction=#{direction} AND partner_id=#{partnerId} AND format=#{format}
SELECT layout_json FROM fin_statement_template WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
